payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information on the practical applications of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating ESE methods for user-generated text.

claims.text: Measuring MAP at gold-k helps evaluate ESE methods in scenarios where coverage of various entity types is crucial, especially in user-generated text.
The MAP at gold-k metric adapts to different concept sizes and provides an estimate of recall, which is important for assessing effectiveness in real-world applications.
